title: Sidohome SG301: A Budget RGB Monitor Light Bar — Pros, Cons and Gaps
summary: The Sidohome SG301 is a low-cost monitor light bar with asymmetric anti-glare lighting, three color temperatures, stepless dimming, a 60-minute timer and an optional RGB backlight. It's sold mainly in Vietnam and its specs are thinly documented — here's what we know.
description:
## Who is it for?

- Students and home offices on a tight budget.
- Gaming setups that want RGB bias lighting.

## Why consider it?

- Anti-glare light aimed at the desk, not the screen.
- 3000K / 4200K / 6500K and stepless dimming.
- USB-C power, optional RGB backlight.

sections.title: What is the Sidohome SG301?
sections.content: Sidohome is a Vietnamese home and desk-lamp brand that sells mainly through Shopee. The SG301 is a light bar that hangs on top of your monitor and lights the desk in front of it, with an RGB variant that also washes color onto the wall behind. It isn't sold on Amazon, and almost all information comes from Sidohome's own store listing.

sections.title: Light quality
sections.content: Like other monitor light bars, it angles light down onto the keyboard to avoid reflections on the screen. It offers three fixed color temperatures (3000K, 4200K, 6500K) plus stepless dimming. Sidohome's description says CRI Ra > 85 while its promo images say Ra > 95; assume the lower figure. Fine for reading and typing, not for color-critical photo or design work.

sections.title: RGB backlight and controls
sections.content: The RGB version has an LED strip on the back with 7 colors and an auto-cycle mode — bias lighting that can make night gaming more comfortable and looks best on a light wall. Four touch buttons handle power/color, a 60-minute auto-off timer, an instant max-brightness neutral mode and the RGB. There's no remote, app or ambient light sensor.

sections.title: Installation and gaps
sections.content: A folding clamp rests on the monitor's top edge, and power comes via USB-C from your monitor, PC or a 5 V charger. Sidohome doesn't publish the bar length, power draw or maximum monitor thickness, so very thick, curved or ultrawide monitors are a gamble. The bar also occupies the spot where a webcam usually sits.

sections.title: Who should buy it — and who shouldn't
sections.content: Buy it if you're in Vietnam and want cheap desk lighting with RGB atmosphere. Skip it if you're outside Vietnam, need well-documented light quality for color work, or want a premium build and warranty — consider BenQ's ScreenBar or Xiaomi's Mi Computer Monitor Light Bar.

sections.title: Sources for this review
sections.content: Zero Technology has not used this light in person. This is a research roundup based on Sidohome's Shopee product listing, user instructions and promotional images, checked November 2026. Specs are incomplete and partly inconsistent, as noted above.

pros: Very low price for a monitor light bar.
Anti-glare light aimed at the desk.
Three color temperatures, stepless dimming and a 60-minute timer.
USB-C power from a monitor or PC.
cons: Key specs (length, power, lux, monitor thickness) not published.
Sold mainly in Vietnam; not on Amazon.
Takes the webcam spot on top of the monitor.
buying_advice: Cheap pick for buyers in Vietnam

faq.question: Standard or RGB version?
faq.answer: Pick RGB if you want bias lighting behind the monitor for gaming; otherwise the standard version does the same desk lighting.

faq.question: Does it cause glare on the screen?
faq.answer: It's designed to angle light down onto the desk, which limits reflections.

faq.question: Does it fit curved monitors?
faq.answer: Sidohome doesn't publish compatibility limits; it sells a separate SF301 for curved monitors.

faq.question: How is it powered?
faq.answer: Via USB-C from a monitor, PC or 5 V USB charger.

faq.question: Can I buy it outside Vietnam?
faq.answer: It's sold mainly on Shopee Vietnam and isn't listed on Amazon. Outside Vietnam, BenQ or Xiaomi light bars are easier to find.
